versions.changelog:
Initial release with powerful music generation and editing through ACE Step Pro Pack:

- Generate high-quality music using ACE Step’s open-weight model directly from the RunComfy CLI.
- Supports tag-driven composition (genre, mood, instruments), optional multilingual lyrics, and detailed section structure.
- Four endpoints: text-to-audio (base and 1.5 for advanced vocals/languages), audio-inpaint (regenerate any time range within a track), and audio-outpaint (extend tracks at ends).
- Fast and affordable: $0.0002–$0.0003 per second, up to 4 minutes per call.
- Flexible schema fields allow detailed prompting, structured lyrics, and precise in-/out-painting with seed control for reproducibility.
